---
title: "03.Multi_ARG_by_diet"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

Assembly-based resistome by diet group and by origin / NOVA diet scores.

Why proportions and contig-level models: the number of ARG contigs grows with sequencing depth and assembly size,
whereas proportions are stable (Zaheer et al. 2018, Sci Rep). Following Li et al. 2024 (Microbiome), outcomes are
modelled at contig level, among ARG-carrying contigs, with logistic mixed models:

outcome ~ exposure + log(contig length) + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth + (1 | sample)

* log(contig length): longer contigs are more likely to carry several ARGs or mobile elements.
* (1 | sample): contigs of the same person are not independent.
* Exposures: diet group (Tukey pairwise odds ratios, as in part 0) or one origin / NOVA score at a time
  (z-scored, BH within system and outcome, as in part 1).
* Sensitivity: sample-level binomial GLM on the proportions (no contig length) and, when assembly statistics are
  available, adding log(assembled Mb) and N50 as covariates.

Outcomes (among ARG contigs): multi-ARG contig (≥ 2 distinct ARGs), contig with a WHO critical ARG, contig with a
highest-priority ARG, multi-ARG contig with a critical ARG and contig with a mobile element.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)

table_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r theme set, include=FALSE}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

system_colors <- c(
  "Origin" = "#338040",
  "NOVA"   = "#4B1D6F")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()))
```


# Data load

```{r data load}
arg_contigs <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_contigs.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_sample_summary <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_sample_summary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
score_info <- read_tsv(here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Tables", "score_info.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(system != "NOVA (sensitivity)")

has_assembly_stats <- "assembly_Mb" %in% names(arg_sample_summary)

sample_covariates <- arg_sample_summary %>%
  select(sample_id, diet_group, sex, age, bmi, log10_depth, assembly_Mb, N50, all_of(score_info$score)) %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
         across(all_of(score_info$score), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z"))

contig_data <- arg_contigs %>%
  mutate(multi_critical = multi_ARG & has_critical) %>%
  inner_join(sample_covariates, by = "sample_id") %>%
  drop_na(sex, age, bmi, log10_depth)

outcomes <- c(
  "multi_ARG"            = "Multi-ARG contig",
  "has_critical"         = "Critical ARG",
  "has_highest_priority" = "Highest-priority ARG",
  "multi_critical"       = "Multi-ARG with critical ARG",
  "has_mobile_element"   = "Mobile element")

covariates <- "log_contig_length + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth"

cat("Contigs:", nrow(contig_data), "| samples:", n_distinct(contig_data$sample_id), "\n")
contig_data %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), across(all_of(names(outcomes)), ~ round(mean(.x) * 100, 1)))
```


# Assembly quality by diet group

If assembly size or contiguity differed between diets, differences in contig-level outcomes could be technical.

```{r assembly quality}
assembly_quality <- arg_sample_summary %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))

assembly_metrics <- c("assembly_Mb" = "Assembled Mb", "N50" = "N50", "n_contigs" = "Number of contigs",
                      "coverage_weighted_Mb" = "Coverage-weighted Mb")

assembly_by_diet <- imap_dfr(assembly_metrics, function(label, metric) {
  kw <- kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(metric, "~ diet_group")), data = assembly_quality)
  fit <- lm(as.formula(paste0("log(", metric, ") ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth")), data = assembly_quality)
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "diet_group")) %>%
    transmute(metric = label, contrast = paste(str_remove(term, "diet_group"), "vs Omnivore"),
              ratio = exp(estimate), p_value = p.value, kruskal_p = kw$p.value)
})

assembly_by_diet

# The same models as Tukey-adjusted pairwise ratios, the adjustment used for every other diet contrast
assembly_tukey <- imap_dfr(assembly_metrics, function(label, metric) {
  fit <- lm(as.formula(paste0("log(", metric, ") ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth")), data = assembly_quality)
  emmeans(fit, pairwise ~ diet_group, adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ") %>%
    transmute(metric = label, group1, group2, ratio = exp(estimate), conf_low = exp(lower.CL),
              conf_high = exp(upper.CL), p_adj = p.value, n = nobs(fit))
})
assembly_tukey

assembly_quality %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(across(names(assembly_metrics), median))

# Depth dependence of assembly size
assembly_quality %>%
  summarise(across(names(assembly_metrics), ~ cor(.x, log10_depth, method = "spearman")))
```


# Diet group

```{r diet models}
fit_diet <- function(outcome, extra = "") {
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ diet_group +", covariates, extra, "+ (1 | sample_id)"))
  glmmTMB(formula_i, data = contig_data, family = binomial)
}

diet_fits <- map(names(outcomes), fit_diet) %>% set_names(names(outcomes))

# Estimated probability for each diet group (other covariates at their mean)
diet_estimates <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, function(fit, outcome) {
  emmeans(fit, ~ diet_group, type = "response") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(outcome, diet_group, estimate = prob, conf_low = asymp.LCL, conf_high = asymp.UCL)
})

# Tukey pairwise odds ratios
diet_comparisons <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, function(fit, outcome) {
  emmeans(fit, pairwise ~ diet_group, type = "response", adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " / ") %>%
    transmute(outcome, group1, group2, odds_ratio = odds.ratio, SE, p.adj = p.value,
              p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                   p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                   p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                   TRUE ~ "ns"))
})

diet_comparisons %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(outcome = outcomes[outcome]) %>% print(n = Inf)

# Convergence of each mixed model (positive-definite Hessian) and the definition of each outcome.
# "has_mobile_element" is the broad flag: any MAP annotation on the contig, including structural evidence.
outcome_definitions <- c(
  "multi_ARG"            = "At least two ARG hits on the contig",
  "has_critical"         = "At least one WHO-critical ARG (CIA, HPCIA or human use only)",
  "has_highest_priority" = "At least one ARG for HPCIA or human-use-only antimicrobials",
  "multi_critical"       = "Multi-ARG contig with at least one WHO-critical ARG",
  "has_mobile_element"   = "Any MGE annotation from MAP (broad flag)")
contig_model_diagnostics <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, ~ tibble(
  outcome = .y, label = outcomes[[.y]], definition = outcome_definitions[[.y]],
  converged = isTRUE(.x$sdr$pdHess), n_contigs = nobs(.x),
  n_samples = n_distinct(contig_data$sample_id), positives = sum(contig_data[[.y]])))
contig_model_diagnostics
```

## Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity}
# 1. Sample-level binomial GLM on proportions (no contig length, no random effect)
sample_level <- arg_sample_summary %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
         n_highest_priority_contigs = NA_real_) %>%
  drop_na(bmi)

sensitivity_sample <- tribble(
  ~outcome,         ~successes,                 ~trials,
  "multi_ARG",      "n_multi_ARG_contigs",      "n_ARG_contigs",
  "has_critical",   "n_critical_contigs",       "n_ARG_contigs",
  "multi_critical", "n_multi_critical_contigs", "n_ARG_contigs",
  "has_mobile_element", "n_mobile_contigs",     "n_ARG_contigs") %>%
  mutate(fit = map2(successes, trials, ~ glm(
    as.formula(paste0("cbind(", .x, ", ", .y, " - ", .x, ") ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth")),
    data = sample_level, family = quasibinomial)),
    coefs = map(fit, ~ tidy(.x, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(str_detect(term, "diet_group")))) %>%
  select(outcome, coefs) %>%
  unnest(coefs) %>%
  transmute(model = "Sample-level quasi-binomial", outcome, term = str_remove(term, "diet_group"),
            odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)

# 2. Assembly statistics as covariates (only when available)
sensitivity_assembly <- if (has_assembly_stats) {
  imap_dfr(map(names(outcomes), fit_diet, extra = "+ log(assembly_Mb) + log(N50)") %>% set_names(names(outcomes)),
           ~ tidy(.x, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
             filter(str_detect(term, "diet_group")) %>%
             transmute(model = "Contig-level + assembly size and N50", outcome = .y,
                       term = str_remove(term, "diet_group"), odds_ratio = estimate,
                       conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value))
} else tibble()

main_vs_omnivore <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, ~ tidy(.x, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
                               filter(str_detect(term, "diet_group")) %>%
                               transmute(model = "Contig-level mixed model (main)", outcome = .y,
                                         term = str_remove(term, "diet_group"), odds_ratio = estimate,
                                         conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value))

diet_sensitivity <- bind_rows(main_vs_omnivore, sensitivity_sample, sensitivity_assembly) %>%
  mutate(contrast = paste(term, "vs Omnivore")) %>%
  select(model, outcome, contrast, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value) %>%
  arrange(outcome, contrast, model)

diet_sensitivity %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(outcome = outcomes[outcome]) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

## Plot

```{r plot functions}
set_relative_pvalue_positions <- function(comparison_df,
                                          estimate_df,
                                          lower_padding = 0.50,
                                          bracket_start = 0.12,
                                          bracket_step = 0.10,
                                          upper_padding = 0.08) {
  data_min <- min(estimate_df$conf_low, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_max <- max(estimate_df$conf_high, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_range <- data_max - data_min

  if (!is.finite(data_range) || data_range == 0) {
    data_range <- abs(data_max) * 0.1
    if (data_range == 0) {
      data_range <- 1}}

  comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
    mutate(y.position = data_max +
             data_range * bracket_start +
             data_range * bracket_step * (row_number() - 1))

  y_lower <- max(0, data_min - data_range * lower_padding)
  y_upper <- max(comparison_df$y.position, na.rm = TRUE) + data_range * upper_padding

  list(comparison = comparison_df,
       limits = c(y_lower, y_upper))}

plot_means <- function(outcome_i) {
  estimate_df <- diet_estimates %>% filter(outcome == outcome_i)
  positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(diet_comparisons %>% filter(outcome == outcome_i), estimate_df)

  ggplot(estimate_df, aes(x = diet_group, y = estimate, colour = diet_group)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, guide = "none") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(positions$comparison,
                       xmin = "group1",
                       xmax = "group2",
                       y.position = "y.position",
                       label = "p.signif",
                       bracket.size = 0.8,
                       tip.length = 0.01,
                       size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = positions$limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(title = outcomes[outcome_i], x = NULL, y = "Probability among ARG contigs") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors), size = 9),
          axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}
```

```{r diet plot, warning=FALSE}
plot_diet <- wrap_plots(map(names(outcomes), plot_means), nrow = 1)
plot_diet
```


# Origin and NOVA scores

```{r score models}
fit_score <- function(score, outcome) {
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste0(score, "_z"), "+", covariates, "+ (1 | sample_id)"))
  fit <- glmmTMB(formula_i, data = contig_data, family = binomial)
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == paste0(score, "_z")) %>%
    transmute(estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)
}

score_results <- expand_grid(score_info, outcome = names(outcomes)) %>%
  mutate(fit = map2(score, outcome, fit_score)) %>%
  unnest(fit) %>%
  group_by(system, outcome) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, conf_low, conf_high), exp),
         endpoint = outcomes[outcome])

score_results %>%
  select(system, label, endpoint, odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, p_adj) %>%
  arrange(endpoint, p_value) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r score plot, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 5}
plot_scores <- score_results %>%
  mutate(system = factor(system, levels = names(system_colors)),
         label = fct_rev(fct_inorder(label)),
         endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = outcomes)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = label, colour = system)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16), labels = c("q ≥ 0.05", "q < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = system_colors, name = "Classification") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(system ~ endpoint, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio per 1-SD increase (log scale)", y = NULL)

plot_scores
```
